tasks.goal: Patrol the Charter Hall perimeter path stopping at five display plinths, logging dwell time at each charter exhibit.
tasks.terrain: Paved plaza surface like Lou Gehrig Plaza; watch curbs, tree wells (113 mapped trees) and garage entrances at 164th Street Garage.
safety_stops: Geofence breach beyond zone polygon stops motion
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the patrol report before it is filed as a charter exhibit record; robot never edits charter content.

tasks.goal: Retrieve labeled research binders from a 3-tier shelf and deliver them to the synthesis desk for agent summarization.
tasks.terrain: Interior lab floor with cable runs and chair legs; shelf height within torso-lift range; threshold strips at doorway.
success: Placement within 5 cm of desk target
Cycle time under 60 s per binder
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher confirms each retrieved binder is the correct one before it enters the evidence log.

tasks.goal: Carry a proposal tablet to designated forum seats during a debate so participants can review drafted proposals in turn.
tasks.terrain: Flat indoor forum floor with chair legs, step edges at seating rows, and clutter under seats.
success: Seat arrival accuracy within 15 cm at 6 seats
Average transit under 25 s per seat
tasks.human_in_loop: A moderator selects the next seat target; the robot never decides debate order or records votes.

tasks.goal: Inspect the operations status wall and router console panels, capturing thermal and text images for the Task Router agent.
tasks.terrain: Deck flooring with cable trays, raised server-rack plinths and stair transition to mezzanine; avoid sliding doors.
success: Thermal anomalies flagged within 2 s of detection
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator reviews flagged thermal anomalies and approves before any maintenance ticket is created.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow scanning pass along the observatory's metric board wall to image progress indicators for the Progress Tracker agent.
tasks.terrain: Indoor flight with ceiling fans off; avoid hanging chart banners, light fixtures and the board frame edges.
success: Wall fully covered in overlapping frames >=60% overlap
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies the scanned board images before metrics are posted to the observatory display.

tasks.goal: Stand at the Charter Hall entrance and gesture visitors toward the charter display using whole-body motion and speech prompts.
tasks.terrain: Entrance threshold and doormat, polished floor with low friction; keep clear of door swing and entry queue rails.
success: Greeting cycle completed 20 times without falls
Gestures point within 15 deg of display
safety_stops: Foot slip detection freezes balance controller
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the greeting script text before deployment; agent-authored scripts are drafts only.

tasks.goal: Stage scanned document stacks onto the synthesis desk feed tray in a repeatable pick-and-place pattern for the synthesis pipeline.
tasks.terrain: Fixed pedestal beside desk; cable bundle and monitor arm within reach envelope; paper stacks lightweight and frangible.
safety_stops: Joint speed limited to 250 mm/s near humans
Plane detection plane category: protective stop when desk edge detected
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab steward confirms stack contents and destination before each batch is staged.
